VERDICT: FAIL

The self-report is the only evidence—no CI log, diff, or independent artifact is attached to verify the claim. Additionally, the described fix (JPY zero-decimal currency) doesn't clearly match the reported symptom (off-by-a-cent on multi-line invoices, which implies a currency that *has* cents), raising doubt that the actual root cause was addressed. Unverifiable claims cannot be accepted as satisfying acceptance criteria.
